title: MS-DIAL analysis-unit triage, version 2
description: One Catalog analysis unit's file selection, decided by an agent before download. Every choice in it is a model inference until a person approves the manifest digest that carries it. One file per unit, named <unit_id>.json (a revision <unit_id>.r<N>.json); the files of one accession sit together in one directory and scripts/validate-triage.py checks them as a set. v2 is v1 plus a confidence and a rationale on every kept and excluded row and member and once for the unit (docs/llm-assisted-curation.md section 2.2). person_answers is no longer written here: a person's answer is a person_answer entry of the accession's review-log.jsonl, so the payload's sha256 never changes after it is written.

catalog_handoff_sha256.description: sha256 of the Catalog handoff copy the triage was made from (inputs/<unit_id>/handoff.json, as the wrapper froze it and as its decision record binds it). The agent cannot hash a file: it copies the value the task prompt gives for the unit.

catalog_row_count.description: Number of sample rows in that handoff. rows and excluded_rows together name every index 0..count-1 exactly once.

standing.description: Everything in a triage file is a model inference. Approving the manifest digest is what makes it an accepted decision.

phase.description: pre_download: made from Catalog rows, mwTab text, names and an archive listing. post_preflight: revised after raw-header preflight.

purpose.description: The analysis_purpose the person stated, verbatim, or null when none was stated for this campaign.

declared.description: What the Catalog unit says, copied as it reads (source fact).

status.description: ready: the selection can go to the plan. needs_person: a question in needs_person must be answered first. abstained: names carry no signal, nothing is assigned. out_of_scope: the unit is outside the campaign scope (for a person to accept). excluded: the unit is left out by a rule a person already accepted (the triage policy of 2026-11-18), with its reason in exclusion; it keeps nothing, asks nothing and holds nothing, and the plan leaves it out (triage_unit_excluded).

exclusion.description: Present exactly when status is excluded: why the triage policy of 2026-11-18 leaves the unit out with no question (docs/llm-assisted-curation.md section 2.2). no_product_ion_files: once its MS1-only files are left out (ms1_only_no_msms) no file with product-ion spectra is left. no_files: the deposit holds no raw file of the unit (its rows name files the archive lacks or another unit's). shared_content_unassigned: the unit's arm's copies are byte-identical to another arm's and no post-download reassignment exists yet; both units are excluded and keep the shared_content flag as evidence.

confidence.description: How sure the agent is of the unit's decision as a whole.

rationale.description: The unit's decision in plain language, one or two sentences.

added_members.description: Archive members the unit keeps that no Catalog row names (pooled QC, blanks).

excluded_members.description: Archive members this unit looked at and left out, with the reason.

children.description: Single-polarity, single-acquisition partition of the kept files. Required before a unit whose ion_mode is both can be ready.

shared_with.description: Files this unit deliberately shares with another unit. Both units must declare the same pair.

polarity_split.description: Present only on a polarity-split child (the author's decision of 2026-11-19), which the campaign plan derives from a needs_person parent whose only question is polarity_switching (validate-triage.py derive_polarity_split): the child's polarity, the reason, the parent's unit id and the sibling's polarity. Never written by the triage agent; a triage file holding it is refused (T-SPLIT).

derived_from.description: Present only on a polarity-split child: the parent payload it was derived from (its path relative to the triage root, and its sha256), the parent's decision record sha256 (null without one), and the decision that split it.

derivation.description: Present when the payload is the expansion of an agent-written spec (schemas/msdial-unit-triage-spec.v1.json) by scripts/expand-triage-spec.py, not hand-written: the spec's file name beside the payload, its sha256 and the expander's version. validate-triage.py re-runs the expander over the inputs the decision record binds and refuses any byte of difference (T-SPEC).

acquisition_mode.description: targeted_DDA is deprecated (decision of 2026-11-18): inclusion- or exclusion-list DDA is DDA, with the informational flag targeted_dda. It stays readable in earlier payloads and counts as DDA in the validator's mixing test.

rule_id.description: The spec group or exception an expanded item came from (scripts/expand-triage-spec.py); absent from a hand-written payload.

reason.description: needs_person (a member held for a person: the unit is not ready and asks), out_of_scope_ms1_only (with an ms1_only flag), ms1_only_no_msms (an MS1-only file, which carries no product-ion spectra, with the informational flag ms1_only_excluded), shared_content_unassigned (in a unit excluded as shared_content_unassigned) and polarity_switching (with its flag) are checked as on a row; no_sample_metadata is a raw file no Catalog row or mwTab Samples line names, left out with no question; out_of_scope is any other scope exclusion.

question_code.description: scope_targeted_dda was removed on 2026-11-18: inclusion- or exclusion-list DDA is in scope and is never a question (the flag targeted_dda informs a report).

flag_code.description: Blocking until a person answers: shared_content (in a unit that is not excluded), folder_header_disagreement, polarity_switching, ms1_only (MS1-only files kept), mixed_acquisition (modes mixed within one run), name_token_disputed. Informational, never blocking: targeted_dda (inclusion- or exclusion-list DDA, in scope; reports note the MS2-selection bias), duplicate_copies_excluded (byte-identical copies among excluded members only), catalog_defect, target_omics_doubt, segmented_acquisition (m/z-segmented DDA kept as separate files), declared_technical_disputed (file evidence contradicts the Catalog's declared technical fields and wins; informational since 2026-11-18), ms1_only_excluded (MS1-only files left out as ms1_only_no_msms), ms1_only_suspected (a weak MS1-only reading; the file is kept for the header preflight to decide).

confidence.description: high: the evidence settles it; medium: the evidence supports it and nothing contradicts it; low: a reading the evidence allows but does not settle. A kept file with basis inferred and confidence low keeps its unit from passing (the validator holds it).

rationale.description: Plain language, one or two sentences: why this decision, from which evidence.
